title: Declarative AB Graph Runner with Autodoc Rollback Hooks
author: Priya Singh
release_notes: Adds a declarative AB graph runner and automatic rollback annotation tooling. Backwards compatible with existing promote/canary manifests. New runbook and e2e tests included.
description: Motivation: enable teams to express A/B experiments as declarative acyclic graphs with explicit transition edges and automated rollback annotations that generate runbook snippets and telemetry links. This PR implements a graph-driven runner that evaluates edges against policy gates (SLOs, cost targets, smoke results) and emits annotated rollback triggers which can be consumed by the operator UI and the abort/autoremediation subsystem. Key goals: reduce imperative rollout scripts, make rollback provenance searchable, and provide autodoc snippets for SRE/playbook. What changed: 1) orchestrator/graph_runner: core evaluator and scheduler for AB graph edges; supports parallel and sequential branches, deterministic cutover semantics, and soft-holdpoints; 2) orchestrator/rollback_annotations: converts policy evaluation results into structured rollback annotations and runbook fragments; 3) manifests: AB graph v1 schema and examples for sessionless and sticky traffic; 4) console: small status UI components to render graph progress and rollback rationale; 5) tests: integration and fuzz tests for edge evaluation and rollback generation; 6) docs: runbook and developer guide with examples and Linear links. Compatibility: existing promote and canary controllers are unchanged; the graph runner is opt-in via an annotation in rollout manifests. Testing: unit coverage added for edge scoring and annotation generation; integration test simulates a failing metric triggering annotated rollback and ensures the merge path and telemetry link are present in generated runbook. Migration notes: no automatic migration required; manifest examples included. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration smoke [x] docs updated [x] runbook snippets generated [x] rollout examples. Rollout plan: merged to main behind feature flag; gradual rollout to staging clusters for two weeks then enable by default for customers opting into A/B graphs. Risks and mitigations: risk of noisy rollbacks when metric thresholds are tight — mitigated by a conservative default threshold, smoothing window, and a dry-run mode that emits but does not act on rollback annotations. Feedback requested on the runbook wording and schema naming.

notes_for_ops: Feature is gated by featureflag 'ab_graph_runner' default disabled. To enable for a cluster: set featureflags.ab_graph_runner=true and apply ab_graph_v1 manifest. Runbook snippets available at /docs/runbooks/ab_graph_rollout.md. Telemetry links include trace id placeholder and can be forwarded to oncall. Monitor rollout.progress and rollout.rollback_triggered metrics.
